I fixed the cleartext error by adding a network security config that permits HTTP only for the emulator host. I haven't built or run the app, so this is verified by reading the code only.

**Cause:** `CatalogClient` requests `BuildConfig.API_BASE_URL`, which points at `http://10.0.2.2/`. Android blocks cleartext HTTP unless the app opts in.

**Changes:**
- **New `app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml`:** sets `cleartextTrafficPermitted="true"` for `10.0.2.2` and `localhost` only. All other hosts still require HTTPS.
- **`app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`:** added `android:networkSecurityConfig="@xml/network_security_config"` to `<application>`.

I scoped it to those two hosts rather than setting `usesCleartextTraffic="true"` app-wide, so release traffic to real servers stays HTTPS-only. If the API will run on a different host or IP, add it to the `<domain>` list. If you want a debug-only config, move the file to `app/src/debug/res/xml/` and keep the manifest reference.
